title: SEO Meta Tags
definition: HTML tags placed in the `<head>` of a document that provide data about the page to search engines (Google, Bing) to help them understand the content and rank it.
simpleExplanation: When Google's robot (Googlebot) visits your website, it's blind. It can't look at your pretty images. It relies on your `Title` and `Meta Description` tags to figure out what your site is about. These tags are exactly what shows up on the Google Search Results page.
realWorldExample: If you search 'Nike shoes', the blue clickable link is the `<title>`, and the gray paragraph underneath it is the `<meta name="description">`.
useCases: Increasing click-through rates (CTR) from search results

basic: What is the ideal length for a Title tag?
intermediate: Does the `<meta name="keywords">` tag help your Google rankings?

answers.question: Ideal length?
answers.answer: Between 50 and 60 characters. If it is longer, Google will chop it off and add '...' at the end.

answers.question: Does meta keywords help?
answers.answer: NO. Google completely ignores the keywords meta tag and has done so since 2009 because people abused it by spamming thousands of irrelevant keywords. Focus on writing good content instead.

codeExample:
Welcome to BeanRoasters

Our metadata ensures you found us on Google!
